title: Personal Credit Cards: raising a billing dispute, the notice window and the temporary credit
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: billing dispute notice and temporary credit

This policy covers how a billing dispute is raised on a Personal Credit Cards account, the window within which the cardholder's notice qualifies, and the temporary credit posted for a qualifying dispute.

## Policy clauses

1. A billing dispute is the cardholder's own claim about one posted purchase, cash advance or balance transfer.
2. The agent registers it with the dispute status submitted and a notice date equal to the day the cardholder gave notice.
3. The notice must be given within the tier's dispute notice window, in calendar days, after the statement on which the charge first appeared.
4. A temporary credit of the claimed amount, never more than the charge, is posted as a provisional dispute credit on the day a qualifying dispute is registered.
5. Only a dispute whose status is submitted can receive a temporary credit.
6. Each dispute receives at most one temporary credit.
7. Disputes about fees, interest or payments are handled as fee or interest reversals, not as billing disputes.

## Notice window by tier

| Card tier | Dispute notice window |
|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 60 calendar days |
| College Rewards Visa | 60 calendar days |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 60 calendar days |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 60 calendar days |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 60 calendar days |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 60 calendar days |

## How the window is counted

- The clock starts from the closing date of the statement on which the disputed charge first appeared, as recorded on that charge.
- The day after that statement date is day 1, and days are counted in calendar days.
- The notice qualifies when the notice date is on or before the statement date plus 60 calendar days; the last day itself qualifies.
- The notice date is the day the cardholder gave notice, recorded on the dispute, which names the disputed charge.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Charge first appeared on the statement closing | Notice given | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 10 March | 9 May (day 60) | qualifies |
| 10 March | 10 May (day 61) | does not qualify |
| 10 March | 11 March (day 1) | qualifies |

A dispute whose notice does not qualify receives no temporary credit.

## Temporary credit points of judgement (hypothetical figures)

- Claimed 120.00 USD on a charge of 95.00 USD: the temporary credit is 95.00 USD, never more than the charge.
- Claimed 40.00 USD on a charge of 95.00 USD: the temporary credit is 40.00 USD, the claimed amount.
- A dispute already carrying a temporary credit receives no second one.
